text:
taylor: Quick heads-up — seeing a small set of requests billed to both org and project after sticky-route tweak. sample req id r-13b.

ivy: Can you paste header dump?

taylor: headers: X-Auth-Subject: token:xyz, X-Origin-Org: org:charlie, X-Resolved-Project: project:charlie-prod. Quota logs show increments for owner=org:charlie and owner=project:charlie-prod for the same trace.

marcus: Sounds like meter-lib increments at auth decode for enforcement and again after attribution. That double-counts.

ivy: Proposal: emit a single canonical header `X-Canonical-Owner` after final resolution. Quota service/billing should prefer that header for counters. Preserve original labels as `X-Auth-Lineage` but only send lineage to debug sinks (no billing).

taylor: Plan: feature-flag `canonical_owner_v1`. When enabled: router emits `X-Canonical-Owner`, meter-lib prefers it, and we emit metric `quota.owner_mismatch` if legacy owner label and canonical differ.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started in staging cluster at 11:02 — image auth-router:canonical-owner-canary.

console-bot: Console owners: dashboards currently group by owner label. Add an alias mapping so historical panels don't break and add a collapsed column "attribution_path" for triage. Do not show high-cardinality lineage by default.

marcus: Tests to add: 
- fallback flow -> only canonical owner billed when flag on
- requests without header -> legacy behavior preserved
- mismatch increments `quota.owner_mismatch`
- billing-pusher dedupe unaffected

ivy: Alerting: if mismatch_rate > 0.5% sustained for 30m post-flip, page oncall and roll back. Also add a short-lived dashboard comparing raw vs canonical counts during canary.

taylor: I'll open PRs for router and meter-lib, include integration replay tests. Creating ticket PLAT-7001 and will attach traces. Ping when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
